title: 1st Source Corporation Reports Record Third Quarter Results, Cash Dividend Declared
summary: QUARTERLY HIGHLIGHTS Net income was $49.54 million for the quarter, up $2.00 million or 4.20% from the previous quarter and up $7.25 million or 17.13%
body_markdown:
**QUARTERLY HIGHLIGHTS**


- Net income was $49.54 million for the quarter, up $2.00 million or 4.20% from the previous quarter and up $7.25 million or 17.13% from the third quarter of 2025. Diluted net income per common share was $2.03, up $0.08 or 4.10% from the previous quarter and up $0.32 or 18.71% from the prior year’s third quarter of $1.71. These results include $3.82 million in pre-tax losses from the sale of approximately $68 million of available-for-sale securities executed in the third quarter as well as a $1.00 million charitable contribution to the 1st Source Bank Foundation.
- Return on average assets was 2.12% for the current quarter, up from 2.06% in the previous quarter and up from 1.86% in the third quarter of 2025. Return on average common shareholders’ equity increased to 14.80% compared to 14.66% in the previous quarter and 13.76% in the third quarter of 2025.
- A cash dividend of $0.45 per common share for the quarter was approved, up five cents or 12.50% from the cash dividend declared a year ago.
- Average loans and leases increased $112.77 million or 1.58% from the previous quarter and $240.08 million, or 3.42% from the third quarter of 2025.
- Tax-equivalent net interest income was $95.74 million, up $2.45 million or 2.62% from the previous quarter and up $6.84 million, or 7.69% from the third quarter a year ago. Tax-equivalent net interest margin was 4.28%, up four basis points from the previous quarter and up 19 basis points from the third quarter of 2025.
- Provision for credit losses of $0.90 million was recorded during the quarter compared to $1.54 million in the previous quarter and $0.90 million during the previous year’s third quarter. The allowance for loan and lease losses as a percentage of total loans and leases was 2.28% at September 30, 2026, down from 2.30% at June 30, 2026 and down from 2.32% as of September 30, 2025.


**South Bend, IN** – 1st Source Corporation (NASDAQ: SRCE), parent company of 1st Source Bank, today reported record quarterly net income of $49.54 million for the third quarter of 2026, up 4.20% compared to $47.54 million reported in the previous quarter and up 17.13% compared to $42.30 million in the third quarter a year ago. Diluted net income per common share for the third quarter of 2026 was $2.03, up 4.10% compared to $1.95 in the previous quarter and up 18.71% versus $1.71 in the third quarter of 2025.


At its October 2026 meeting, the Board of Directors approved a cash dividend of $0.45 per common share, up five cents or 12.50% from the cash dividend declared a year ago. The cash dividend is payable to shareholders of record on November 3, 2026, and will be paid on November 13, 2026.


Andrea G. Short, President and Chief Executive Officer, commented, “We are pleased to announce that we achieved record quarterly net income during the third quarter along with net interest margin expansion and an improved efficiency ratio. Average loans and leases grew $112.77 million, up 1.58% while average deposits increased marginally due to seasonal outflows of public fund deposits, compared to the previous quarter. Average year-to-date deposits, net of brokered deposits, increased $238.74 million or 3.50% compared to the prior year. Strong credit quality continued during the quarter with low net charge-offs, a lower provision for credit losses, and a reduction in nonperforming assets. Our liquidity and capital positions remained strong during the quarter.


“We were excited to launch the Payments Hub platform for our Treasury Services clients, offering significant time savings and efficient payment routing. This new platform modernizes and simplifies payment operations for single, electronic payments by bringing payment activities into a centralized platform. It incorporates standard ACH, FedNow®, Real-Time Payments® and Instant Payments®, all of which offer different combinations of speed, cost, and availability. Rather than requiring our clients to become experts in each payment type, this new platform uses intelligent payment routing, which chooses the best payment choice balancing speed and costs.


“We were very pleased to learn during the third quarter that 1st Source Bank was named to the American Banker list of 2026 Top-Performing Banks with $2 billion to $10 billion in assets. Banks were ranked on their three-year average return on average equity, or ROAE, using year-end 2025 data compiled by S&P Global Market Intelligence and analyzed by Capital Performance Group (CPG). Additionally, 1st Source was included in Bank Director’s RankingBanking list of The Best U.S. Banks in 2026, which ranks the 300 largest publicly traded banks.


“Another welcome honor was when two of our Board members along with myself, were named on the Indiana 250 list by IBJ Media. Chris Murphy, our Executive Chairman, and Tracy Graham were both included in the list that highlights the most influential business leaders in Indiana. We are honored to have this level of experience and leadership on our Board of Directors.” Mrs. Short concluded.
